inputs.text: We are witnessing yet another transparent power grab by the ruling elite who consistently prioritize their own unchecked authority over the needs of the working class and marginalized communities. Former Zengeza West legislator and opposition leader Job Sikhala rightly stood up at a press conference to call for the total rejection of these proposed constitutional amendments, which are transparently aimed at extending President Emmerson Mnangagwa’s term of office to 2030. When leadership seeks to manipulate the foundational laws of the land just to cling to power, it is a direct assault on democratic accountability and institutional integrity, leaving vulnerable populations to bear the brunt of systemic oppression and neglected social needs. Sikhala heavily criticised what he described as [...] as he took aim at Constitutional Amendment Bill 3, and we must stand in absolute solidarity with anyone resisting this entrenchment of authoritarian governance.
